name: funkybasic
summary: Agility Course WR holder. TexasPete credits him for movement strats. His run notes describe surge edge jumps (zoops), autowalk headstarts and construction manipulations. He has not run the raid.

insights.text: Well done Pete! That's what I like to see! I have not gotten to this part of the game yet but I look forward to try at this too :D

Time in accordance with the in-game timer. Video upload shows the run from start to finish. 

If there are any mistakes regarding the upload or the format, please let me know for corrections. The recording has been made with Steams automatic recording software from which I've clipped the uploaded video. The game is ran on current patch (1.0.0.6).

insights.text:
Played and recorded on Steam 2026-10-03.
Played on patch 1.0.0.6.

Used spells pre- and mid-run, and found a super cheese head-start with autowalk enabled. Discored by sheer accident. Is it too scummy you think?

Time and run can beaten with cleaner movement and autowalk by someone else I'm sure.

insights.text:
Played and recorded on patch 1.0.0.6, 2026-10-05.
Using spells pre-run, stamina pot, autowalk cheese at the start and some movement tech and contruction manipulations. I can say I am completely out of more ideas for now :P

We're really pushing the meaning of any% now...

insights.text:
Played on patch 1.0.0.6, recorded 2026-10-05. First sub-50 run!

Used spells pre-run, 1 agility pot, and some cheeky auto-walk cheese at the start.

Pete, back to the graveyards!

What will Jagex do about this?

insights.text:
Was just messing around a bit waiting for a friend to come online and I happen to get this. Still trying to figure out a strategy to get sub-30 but I don't see it just yet.

insights.text:
Played on patch 1.0.0.8 on 2026-10-08.
I cooked as much as I could for now. Autowalk sprint for head start, surge edge jumps at two locations, some consctruction additions to the course and 1 agility potion at the second half of the run. I did some minor fuckups in my opinion so I suppose it could be beat without too many changes. 

See you at the graveyards, Pete!
insights.verification_note: Agility/other category; movement tech context only

insights.text:
Played on patch 1.0.0.8.

I cooked as much as I had the energy to. Run still was not perfect, I could shave it down by a second. Perhaps even get it down to sub-40. Used all the tricks I have at my disposal. Pushing the meaning of any%.
insights.verification_note: Agility/other category; movement tech context only

insights.text: First submitted run on this agility course. Cmon lads, let's try mess with this one too. Didn't pull out all my tricks just yet.
insights.verification_note: Agility/other category; movement tech context only

insights.text:
Played and recorded on 2026-10-11. Patch 1.0.0.8.

Used most of my tricks, but **building is not permitted in this area** so no contruction manipulations are possible as of yet. Until I figure out a way to break that too :P

Oh but I managed to recontruct an old head-start cheese from the beta-days since I was not able to replicate the auto-walk cheese on this course as of yet.
insights.verification_note: Agility/other category; movement tech context only

insights.text:
First proper submitted glitchless run! See you on the other courses fellas!

No headstart cheese of any kind and no contruction additions. Only spells, proper movement and surge edge jumps, and 1 stamina potion.
